title: Herby Labneh Phyllo Pie
description: A refreshing vegetarian dish from the Middle East, perfect for warm weather. This pie combines the creaminess of labneh cheese with fresh herbs.
instructions: Thaw the filo pastry according to the package instructions.
In a bowl, mix together labneh cheese, parsley, mint, garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Brush the bottom of a baking dish with olive oil.
Place a sheet of filo pastry in the baking dish and brush with olive oil.
Repeat the process with the remaining filo pastry, creating a layered pie.
Spoon the labneh mixture into the pie and smooth the top.
Fold the excess filo pastry over the filling to create a neat edge.
Bake the pie for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
